checks.description: tools/oidc-verifier está en tablero con su pyproject.toml y su uv.lock
Los tests unitarios de oidc-verifier pasan en local
checks.cmd: cd tools/oidc-verifier && uv sync --locked -q && uv run --no-sync pytest tests/unit -q

checks.description: ci-tools.yml prueba tools/oidc-verifier llamando al _python.yml del repo central, sin integración
deploy-gate.yml tiene un job staging con environment staging y un job production con environment production que necesita a staging
deploy-gate.yml declara concurrency en la raíz sin cancel-in-progress
Solo los jobs staging y production de deploy-gate.yml piden id-token: write
checks.cmd: yq -N '(select(.permissions."id-token" == "write") | filename + ":raíz"), (.jobs | to_entries | .[] | select(.value.permissions."id-token" == "write") | filename + ":" + .key)' .github/workflows/*.yml | sed 's#.*/##' | sort | tr '\n' ' '

checks.description: Solo escriben codeql (security-events), deploy-gate (id-token), images (packages), labeler y pr-report (pull-requests) y nightly (actions); ningún write-all ni read-all
checks.cmd: grep -rlE 'permissions: *(write|read)-all' .github/workflows; yq -N '.jobs | to_entries | .[] | .value.permissions // {} | to_entries | .[] | select(.value == "write") | (filename | sub(".*/"; "")) + ":" + .key' .github/workflows/*.yml | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
checks.assert: stdout~^codeql.yml:security-events deploy-gate.yml:id-token images.yml:packages labeler.yml:pull-requests nightly.yml:actions pr-report.yml:pull-requests $

checks.description: Los dos jobs de deploy-gate.yml dan a PostgreSQL el secreto DATABASE_PASSWORD de su environment
Los dos jobs de deploy-gate.yml pasan su token OIDC por stdin a oidc-verifier con el sub esperado de vars.OIDC_SUB
checks.cmd: yq '[.jobs[].steps[] | select((.run // "" | test("ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL")) and (.run | test("\|\s*uv run --no-sync oidc-verifier")) and (.env.EXPECTED_SUB // "" | test("vars\.OIDC_SUB")))] | length' .github/workflows/deploy-gate.yml

checks.description: Ningún run ni script de github-script contiene una expresión ${{ }}: secretos, variables y datos llegan por env
Los environments staging y production solo admiten despliegues desde la rama main
checks.cmd: for e in staging production; do printf '%s=%s:%s ' "$e" "$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/$e" --jq '.deployment_branch_policy.custom_branch_policies')" "$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/$e/deployment-branch-policies" --jq '[.branch_policies[] | .type + "/" + .name] | join(",")')"; done

checks.description: production exige la aprobación de un revisor antes de ejecutar su job
DATABASE_PASSWORD existe como secreto de staging y de production, y no como secreto del repositorio
checks.cmd: printf 'repo=%s staging=%s production=%s' "$(gh secret list --json name --jq '[.[] | select(.name == "DATABASE_PASSWORD")] | length')" "$(gh secret list --env staging --json name --jq '[.[] | select(.name == "DATABASE_PASSWORD")] | length')" "$(gh secret list --env production --json name --jq '[.[] | select(.name == "DATABASE_PASSWORD")] | length')"

checks.description: El sub del token OIDC de tablero usa la plantilla repo, context y job_workflow_ref
Cada environment guarda en la variable OIDC_SUB el sub exacto que acepta: su environment y deploy-gate.yml en main
checks.cmd: for e in staging production; do v=$(gh variable list --env "$e" --json name,value --jq '.[] | select(.name == "OIDC_SUB") | .value'); grep -qE "^repo:[^:]+/tablero[^:]*:environment:$e:job_workflow_ref:[^:]+/tablero/\.github/workflows/deploy-gate\.yml@refs/heads/main$" <<<"$v" && printf '%s=ok ' "$e" || printf '%s=mal ' "$e"; done

checks.description: Los workflows de tablero pasan actionlint y zizmor con las auditorías online sin hallazgos
ci-tools y deploy-gate, con la aprobación de production, terminan en success sobre el último commit de main
checks.cmd: git fetch -q origin main && sha=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && for w in ci-tools deploy-gate; do printf '%s=%s ' "$w" "$(gh run list --workflow $w.yml --commit "$sha" --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion')"; done
